subject: Embeddings latency spike after model-catalog deploy — NimbleSearch escalation
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@nimblesearch.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 08:12:03 -0700
Subject: Production embeddings latency spike since catalog update

Markus / Vanessa,

We started seeing a sharp regression in embeddings latency for production requests to the Redwood hosted embeddings endpoint right after the model catalog update this morning (around 07:28 PDT). p95 for our embedding calls jumped from ~120ms to ~1.8s and p99 to ~6.2s. Throughput has also dropped intermittently and a small percentage (~0.6%) of calls returned 502/timeout.

Examples (all from api key nimble-prod-01):
- request_id: a3f9c2e4-9876-4a1c-9b5a, ts: 2026-05-05T07:29:07Z, latency: 6200ms
- request_id: a3f9d1b0-1111-45b7-8a2d, ts: 2026-05-05T07:33:12Z, latency: 1820ms

We captured traces and a small perf dump (attached: nimble_traces_0505.jsonl). This started immediately after your catalog deploy that remapped some embeddings variants (catalog-v20260505). Can you confirm whether a model variant or routing change was made that could increase tokenization/compile time? This is urgent for our search relevance job — we have a customer-facing outage.

Please advise next steps and ETA for mitigation.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Head of Platform
NimbleSearch Inc.

(attachments: nimble_traces_0505.jsonl)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Cc: rachel_kim@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 08:40:42 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production embeddings latency spike since catalog update — incident PD-1234 opened

Opened PD incident PD-1234 (link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-1234). Initial triage:
- Correlation with catalog-v20260505 confirmed. We see a spike in model load/compile time for the embeddings variant mapping that was introduced. The path that selects quantized kernels appears to be falling back to a slower float kernel for a subset of shards leading to repeated JIT/compile events.
- Impact: increased per-request CPU + blocking GPU compile; downstream queueing -> p95/p99 regressions and some 502s when timeouts hit.
- Workaround: roll routing for NimbleSearch to the previous embeddings model id (model:e2e-embed-v2-stable) which avoids the new variant mapping.

Actions taken:
- Applied a targeted routing override for account nimble-search (nimble-prod-01) at 08:38 PDT.
- Collected span traces (attached: span-trace-req-987654.txt) and sample perf dump.

Next: monitor p95/p99 for 30 mins; if improved, schedule a canary rollback of catalog mapping and add a guardrail to prevent automatic variant fallback for busy shards.

— Jonas
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Elaine

- Customer impact window: 07:28–08:38 PDT for NimbleSearch (confirmed by traces + metrics). p95/p99 spike; small % of 502s.
- Mitigation taken: targeted routing override applied at 08:38; global canary rollback of the catalog mapping in progress; monitor until 11:00 PDT.

3) Dev / SE: reproduce with nimble sample payloads and confirm rollback avoids issue (due 2hrs).
4) Laura / Sales Ops: confirm credit band and sign-off on customer communication (due EOD).
